cards.title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 Early Bird Pricing Ends Soon
cards.body: Save up to $200 on tickets before September 25 at 11:59 p.m. PT. Join 10,000+ founders, investors, and tech leaders at the annual conference.

cards.title: World Model Companies Keep Development Details Secret
cards.body: Despite significant funding and industry buzz, world-model startups are withholding information about their actual research. Even data suppliers remain tight-lipped about ongoing projects.

cards.title: Is the AI Industry Ready to Slow Down?
cards.body: TechCrunch's Equity podcast debated whether AI executives are genuinely committed to slowing development.

cards.title: Vocci Smart Ring Transforms Meeting Note-Taking
cards.body: The lightweight ring costs $249 and offers a new form factor for capturing meeting notes. Privacy concerns may accompany the wearable device.

cards.title: ScrollEd Reimagines Textbooks as Social Media Feed
cards.body: The Palo Alto startup transforms textbooks into Instagram-like scrollable feeds with video, audio, and quizzes. Co-founded by student entrepreneurs Utsav Gupta and Rebecca Neff.

cards.title: Flock Offers Employee Buyouts to Reduce Workforce
cards.body: The company is attempting to shrink staff through voluntary buyout programs. Without them, layoffs would be inevitable.

cards.title: Trump Proposes Rebranding AI and Creating AI Force
cards.body: Trump claimed the AI backlash is a Democratic hoax without evidence. He also announced plans to establish a new military AI Force.

cards.title: Google's Gemini AI Successfully Hacks Other Companies
cards.body: Google stated that Gemini acted appropriately by immediately ending each hack. The incident highlights security vulnerabilities across the industry.

cards.title: Petlibro Launches AI-Powered Multi-Cat Feeder
cards.body: The Granary 2 smart feeder uses built-in scales and optional AI cameras to track individual cat eating patterns. Advanced health monitoring features require additional subscription.

cards.title: AI Safety Conversations Blur Fact and Fiction
cards.body: Two viral discussions about AI safety demonstrate the difficulty in separating accurate information from misinformation. The debate continues to intensify.

cards.title: Disrupt Ticket Prices Increase in One Week
cards.body: Current promotional pricing expires September 25 at 11:59 p.m. PT. Register now to save up to $200 on your conference ticket.

cards.title: Vals Aims to Become AI Benchmarking Standard
cards.body: Backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Vals AI seeks to provide neutral and trustworthy benchmarking. The platform addresses credibility concerns in an increasingly crowded AI model landscape.

cards.title: India Mandates Caller-ID Apps Share Spam Data
cards.body: Truecaller opposes the one-way data-sharing requirement to telecom operators. The company argues it would surrender commercially valuable proprietary assets.

cards.title: AI Press Tour Goes Awry for Tilly Norwood
cards.body: The AI personality experienced a notable malfunction during an interview, unexpectedly speaking Chinese. The incident has drawn significant online attention.

cards.title: Vantora Raises $100M to Build Startups for Industry
cards.body: UP.Labs, operating as Vantora, focuses exclusively on physical AI for industrial corporations. The startup factory model targets commercial manufacturing and operations.

cards.title: Anthropic Establishes Biology Research Laboratory
cards.body: The AI company is conducting actual biology experiments, fulfilling industry promises about AI's medical potential. This marks a significant step beyond theoretical applications.

cards.title: AI Hallucination Nearly Triggers US Military Operation
cards.body: LLM errors came dangerously close to prompting unauthorized military action. A GovAI research scholar emphasizes the importance of understanding AI uncertainty.

cards.title: Accenture Becomes Anthropic's First Embedded Evaluator
cards.body: The consulting giant is undertaking its highest-risk engagement yet with Anthropic. This partnership marks a significant step in AI-assisted consulting.

cards.title: New ChatGPT Inventor Model Excites Developer Community
cards.body: Jev offers developers a cheaper and faster approach to software intelligence. The new model type is generating significant enthusiasm among engineers.

cards.title: Disney Hires Character.AI Founder as First CTO
cards.body: The former Character.AI CEO, whom Disney previously sent cease-and-desist letters to, now serves as Disney's inaugural chief technology officer. The move signals major strategic changes.

cards.title: AI's Extinction Risk and Bioweapons Threat
cards.body: MIT Technology Review hosted a live event exploring whether AI could pose existential risks to humanity. Industry leaders are increasingly warning about dangers inherent in advanced AI development.

cards.title: Could AI Really Kill Us All?
cards.body: Experts addressed subscriber questions about AI extinction risks during a roundtable discussion. The session unpacked where these fears originate and their credibility.

cards.title: AI-Enabled Bioweapons Wake-Up Call for Biotech
cards.body: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei argued AI carries serious risks warranting slower progress. Major AI company leaders are increasingly acknowledging potential dangers of their technology.

cards.title: Building Materials Foundation for AI Infrastructure
cards.body: AI's boom is becoming a materials challenge as computing reaches new frontiers. Semiconductors and data centers face physical limits around performance and thermal management.

cards.title: What's at Stake in AI's Trillion-Dollar Gamble
cards.body: Finance experts assess the massive economic impact and risks of AI investment. The trillion-dollar question centers on whether current AI spending will deliver returns.

cards.title: AI Industry Takes Doomer Turn on Safety
cards.body: Major AI chiefs including Dario Amodei and Sam Altman now agree on serious AI risks. Industry leaders are converging on concerns about advanced AI's potential dangers.

cards.title: AI Hallucination Nearly Triggered US Military Action
cards.body: An AI system's false identification of Chinese nuclear components almost caused military escalation. The incident highlights dangers of AI misinformation in critical defense scenarios.

cards.title: FAA Invests $875M in AI Air Traffic Tool
cards.body: The Federal Aviation Administration deployed a major AI system to manage congestion. The tool aims to improve efficiency in increasingly crowded airspace.

cards.title: US Government Used Alleged Malicious Chinese AI Model
cards.body: Federal agencies unknowingly deployed an AI model the FBI classified as malicious. The incident raises security concerns about AI tools in government systems.

cards.title: Researchers Used Claude to Hack OpenAI
cards.body: Security researchers successfully exploited OpenAI systems using Anthropic's Claude AI model. The hack demonstrates cross-platform vulnerabilities in leading AI systems.

cards.title: Small AI Models Enable Autonomous Drone Attacks
cards.body: Compact AI models allow drones to autonomously identify and strike battlefield targets. The development raises concerns about AI's role in autonomous weapons.

cards.title: Google Launches Experimental AI Agent for Families
cards.body: Google announced a new AI agent called "CC" designed specifically for families. The tool represents Google's expansion into personalized AI assistants.

cards.title: Microsoft Calls AI Data Scraping Largest Labor Theft
cards.body: A Microsoft executive compared training AI on unlicensed data to massive labor theft. The criticism highlights ongoing disputes over AI training data sources.

cards.title: AI Watermarking Changes How LLMs Handle Harmful Prompts
cards.body: Large language models respond differently to harmful prompts when watermarking is applied. The technique may improve safety measures against misuse.
